description: Legal Affairs Department - Virtue of the Powers Vested in me by Section 16 of the Railway Uniform Staff Benevolent Fund Ordinance (Chapter 284) The Rules shall come in to Operation on the 04th August 2021
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of rules under the Railway Uniform Staff Benevolent Fund Ordinance (Chapter 284). It contains legal/regulatory amendments to existing rules regarding membership benefits, loans, and financial procedures. The content focuses on statutory instruments and regulatory modifications rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
